# Preserved Topic

The last valid synthesis remains readable while an external write is malformed.

## Context

This first section establishes enough content to make the detail pane scroll.

## Evidence one

Primary evidence remains attached to the stable Wiki Page identity. The Research Catalog refreshes only the changed path and does not rebuild unrelated Topics.

## Evidence two

A malformed save preserves this valid prose. The warning identifies when the bad refresh was detected and offers an Obsidian repair action.

## Evidence three

Selection follows the stable Wiki Page ID rather than its path. Renames and moves therefore leave the user on the same Topic.

## Evidence four

The detail reader keeps its vertical offset while the warning appears. Reading does not jump back to the top during a transient write.

## Evidence five

A later valid save clears the warning and replaces the preserved snapshot without requiring navigation or a full Catalog scan.

## Evidence six

Expired and low-confidence knowledge stays readable. Freshness changes the primary knowledge action rather than creating workflow state.

## Evidence seven

Research remains a live lens over schema-governed Wiki Pages. Glasswork never copies the synthesis into a second source of truth.

## Evidence eight

Concurrent edits are serialized behind the Catalog seam and emitted as targeted stable-ID deltas.

## Evidence nine

Same-process watcher echoes are consumed precisely, while a later Obsidian or agent edit to the same path still refreshes the desktop Catalog.

## Evidence ten

Durable deletion removes the Topic only after the watcher quiet period confirms that the Wiki Page did not return as part of an atomic save.

## Evidence eleven

The warning is part of the selected Topic detail rather than a global reload banner. Unrelated Topics remain readable and retain their own metadata.

## Evidence twelve

The Catalog stores the last valid parsed candidate and derives freshness again at the explicit query date. Cached prose does not freeze the trust signal.

## Evidence thirteen

Missing confidence, updated, expires, or sources metadata produces an incomplete signal. It does not hide the Topic or invent a workflow status.

## Evidence fourteen

Low confidence takes precedence over incomplete metadata, and expiration takes precedence over low confidence, so the most actionable trust problem remains visible.

## Evidence fifteen

The compact list keeps a three-line density while the detail pane remains dominant. This follows the Balanced Library production decision.

## Evidence sixteen

Open in Obsidian remains the repair path for malformed Wiki metadata. Glasswork does not edit synthesis prose or create a second renderer.

## Evidence seventeen

The watcher applies existing paths before missing paths in one quiet-period batch, allowing delete-plus-create rename sequences to converge atomically.

## Evidence eighteen

Stable-ID deltas let the page replace only changed rows. The selected Topic and its reader remain intact when an unrelated page changes.

## Evidence nineteen

A real external edit after a same-process write still reaches the Catalog. Suppression covers only the watcher burst associated with the registered write.

## Evidence twenty

This final section provides enough rendered content for the visual scenario to establish and verify a nonzero reading position.
